kv4.7:5.3: Yādiso Bodhisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā, dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā, tādiso Cakkavattisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā, dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanā ti?
kv4.7:6.1: Yathā Bodhisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti, pacchā manussā; evameva Cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti, pacchā manussā ti?
kv4.7:7.1: Yathā Bodhisattassa jāyamānassa cattāro devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti,
kv4.7:7.3: mahesakkho tava putto uppanno ti"; evameva Cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa cattāro devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti,
kv4.7:8.1: Yathā Bodhisattassa jāyamānassa dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti,
kv4.7:8.3: yena Bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti, mātu ca; evameva Cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti,
kv4.7:8.5: yena Bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti, mātu cāti?
kv4.7:9.1: Yathā sampatijāto Bodhisatto samehi pādehi paṭiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho satta padavītihāre gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñ ca vācaṃ bhāsati,
kv4.7:9.2: "Aggo' haṃ asmi lokassa, jeṭṭho 'haṃ asmi lokassa, seṭṭho 'haṃ asmi lokassa, ayaṃ antimā jāti, n' atth' idāni punabbhavo ti"; evameva sampatijāto Cakkavattisatto samehi pādehi paṭiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho satta padavītihāre gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñ ca vācaṃ bhāsati,
kv4.7:9.3: Aggo 'haṃ asmi lokassa, jeṭṭho 'haṃ asmi lokassa, seṭṭho 'haṃ asmi lokassa, ayaṃ antimā jāti, n' atth' idāni punabbhavo ti"?
kv4.7:10.1: Yathā Bodhisattassa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hoti, evameva Cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hotīti?
kv4.7:11.1: Yathā Bodhisattassa pakatikāyo samantā byāmaṃ obhāsati, evameva Cakkavattisattassa pakatikāyo samantā byāmaṃ obhāsatīti?
kv4.7:12.1: Yathā Bodhisatto mahāsupinaṃ passati, evameva Cakkavattisatto mahāsupinaṃ passatīti?
kv4.7:13.5: "Dvattiṃs' imāni Bhikkhave mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dve 'va gatiyo bhavanti, anaññā;
kv4.7:13.6: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti Cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato;
kv4.7:13.7: tass' imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyathāpīdaṃ --
kv4.7:13.8: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanaṃ eva sattamaṃ,
kv4.7:13.9: parosahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūravīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā,
kv4.7:13.10: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati,
kv4.7:13.11: sace pana kho agārasmā anāgāriyaṃ pabbajjati, Arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado ti."
